summary: Backend-only testing for Grihkari MVP. Created pytest suite (conftest + 2 test modules) and ran 22 tests covering auth (signup/login/me/duplicate/auto-link), clients CRUD with role gating, entries (create/totals/return), bills (generate/aggregate/mark-paid), reports (monthly/yearly/by-client), client-side endpoints (entries via linked_user_id, /my/iron-men), and subscription (plans + placeholder activation). 22/22 passed (100%). Test data prefixed with TEST_ and cleaned up after use.

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of 201 for resource creation. Functional but not REST-conventional.
MOCKED - placeholder for Razorpay; locally activates without payment verification (expected per PRD).
Ignores client_id query param silently for clients (uses linked_user_id only). Acceptable but undocumented.

action_items: Optional: Return 201 from /api/auth/signup and /api/clients/POST and /api/entries/POST for REST conventions.
Wire actual Razorpay verification in /api/subscription/activate before production (currently MOCKED placeholder).
Consider adding rate-limit / brute-force protection on /api/auth/login (no throttling observed).
JWT_SECRET defaults to a hardcoded dev string if env var missing — ensure JWT_SECRET is set in production env.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 841 lines — close to the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth, clients, entries, bills, reports, subscription).
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') are deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager.
_refresh_subscription only flips trial→expired but never active→expired check works only on login/me; cron-style refresh not implemented (acceptable for MVP).
No pagination on /api/entries, /api/bills, /api/clients — may be slow at scale.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec (browsers will reject credentialed requests). Tighten origins in production.
seed_data_creation: Used seed users from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (9999999991 iron_man / 9999999992 client). Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed clients/entries within tests. Iron man subscription was activated to 'active' state by test_activate_for_iron — note: subsequent manual checks may see active status until 30 days elapse.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/*.py. Tests are idempotent (signup-or-login pattern). Base URL hardcoded to external preview. After running, the seed iron_man user (9999999991) will have subscription_status=active (set by test_activate_for_iron). To reset, manually update users collection or delete and re-signup.
